title: Write the prompt template
description: This shell command creates prompt.txt with promptfoo's answer template.

steps.description: python3 constructs the template text instead of requiring you to type curly braces.
The two multiplied brace strings produce two opening and two closing braces around answer.

steps.question: What variable name appears between the two pairs of curly braces?
steps.answer: The template contains answer, so promptfoo echoes the stored answer value.

steps.description: The shell redirection writes that one-line template into prompt.txt.
